# Schur

![Schur function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/29-schur.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Schur decomposition A=Z*T*Z^H. result is Schur form, vectors are Z, eigenvalues are always complex. compute_vectors defaults false. U16 order 0 unchanged, 1/2 real part ascending/descending, 3/4 modulus ascending/descending; ordering must preserve factor consistency. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: compute_vectors=false, order=0.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Schur**

Décompose A=Z·T·Zᴴ. Renvoie T, Z si demandé et les valeurs propres complexes. Ordre : 0 inchangé, 1/2 partie réelle croissante/décroissante, 3/4 module croissant/décroissant. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : compute_vectors=false, order=0.

</details>
